preprocessing.textNormalization: publisher BertNormalizer: clean_text=true, handle_chinese_chars=true, strip_accents=null, lowercase=false; see golden token IDs

multilingual-text-v1.outputNormalization: External mask-weighted mean of last_hidden_state, publisher linear.weight projection 768→512, then L2 normalization

projection.format: safetensors; little-endian uint64 header length then UTF-8 JSON then raw tensor bytes

preprocessing.resize: bilinear resize to 224x224; no center crop

siglip2-base-v1.outputNormalization: Select pooler_output by name (not last_hidden_state), then external L2 normalization; FP32 public I/O, FP16 internal weights/operators
siglip2-base-v1.textAttentionMask: ONNX text tower accepts input_ids only; preserve all 64 padded positions as publisher SigLIP inference

preprocessing.resize: bilinear resize to 256x256; no center crop

siglip2-large-v1.outputNormalization: Select pooler_output by name (not last_hidden_state), then external L2 normalization; image tower FP32, text tower FP16 internal weights/operators with FP32 public I/O. FP16 image was rejected after Android auxiliary-output parity failed.
siglip2-large-v1.textAttentionMask: ONNX text tower accepts input_ids only; preserve all 64 padded positions as publisher SigLIP inference

preprocessing.specialTokens: no BOS; append EOS ID 1; truncate to 64 including EOS
preprocessing.textNormalization: exact tokenizers JSON Replace(space, ▁) plus Split(space, MergedWithPrevious); preserve case/punctuation as observed. GemmaTokenizerFast ignores legacy do_lower_case=true config; golden tests are authoritative. Do not substitute SiglipTokenizer (SigLIP 1).

preprocessing.resize: Lik policy: preserve aspect ratio, bilinear fit into 640x640 and pad right/bottom with zero; map coordinates back. The pinned ONNX is fixed 640x640 (not the OpenCV demo 320 setting).

preprocessing.normalization: none externally; pinned graph contains (x-127.5)/128 through scalar ops
preprocessing.alignment: similarity transform from YuNet eye/nose/mouth landmarks; bilinear warp to 112x112

sface-v1.outputNormalization: external L2 normalization of fc1; threshold is a calibration parameter, not a measured Lik match guarantee

preprocessing.resize: Exact publisher DetResizeForTest resize_long=960: ratio=960/max(h,w), truncate scaled h/w to integers, ceil each to multiple of 128, bilinear resize; preserve separate x/y ratios when mapping boxes. Tiny inputs with h+w<64 are padded before this transform. This is resize_type2, not the limit_side_len/32 variant.

postprocessing.algorithm: DBPostProcess quadrilaterals; probability map threshold 0.3; box score >=0.6; max candidates 1000; unclip_ratio=1.5; map to original oriented size

preprocessing.width: Lik baseline 320; preserve aspect ratio, resize width=min(320,ceil(48*aspect)), pad right with normalized zero; vertical crops rotate 90 degrees before resize when height/width>=1.5

postprocessing.algorithm: CTC greedy argmax; remove repeated adjacent IDs and blank 0; dictionary characters.txt plus trailing space; dictionary entries index+1; preserve case and Cyrillic
postprocessing.confidence: mean of selected nonblank timestep probabilities

ocr-cyrillic-rec-v1.characterDictionaryArtifact: ocr-cyrillic-rec-v1/characters.txt; exact 850 publisher dictionary entries; append a space and prepend CTC blank index 0 to match 852 classes

sensitive-v1.architecture: vit_tiny_patch16_384; hidden dimension 192; 12 transformer blocks; 3 attention heads

preprocessing.resize: bicubic shorter side 384 then centered 384x384 crop (timm crop_pct=1.0, crop_mode=center)

output.name: logits
output.normalization: external numerically stable softmax; score index 0

sensitive-v1.scope: Publisher training covers photos, drawings, memes and generated imagery. This is a sexual/NSFW-content screening signal; it does not certify absence of every kind of private or sensitive information.

calibration.required: separate reviewed calibration/test fixtures; freeze per-artifact threshold before automatic safe decisions; no data means remain unclassified/quarantined

sensitive-v1.privacyContract: docs/SENSITIVE_MEDIA.md; manual overrides separate; highest scheduler priority after import/change; hidden by default
